material_changes: Separate bare sth abounds = many instances exist from place/text abounds in/with sth = contains many.
Promote both subject frames into explicit constructions so the learner does not reverse the argument structure.

core_clusters.label_en: exist in large numbers or amounts

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 某类事物大量存在；也可说某个地方/文本“充满”某物
core_concept.core_meaning_en: to exist in large numbers, or for a place, text, or system to contain many examples of something
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 看主语：Theories abound = 理论很多；The text abounds in examples = 文本里例子很多。
core_concept.mental_model_en: watch the subject frame: things abound; a place/text abounds in or with those things

overrides.definition_en: to exist in large numbers or amounts; in abound in/with, to contain many examples of something
overrides.sense_label_en: exist in large numbers; be full of
overrides.governing_pattern: vi.; subject + abound / container + abound in/with + n

constructions.learning_note: The container is the subject; the plentiful things follow in/with.

material_changes: Keep topic, approximation, and around/movement senses but organize them under a clearer semantic map.
Retain be about to and add how/what about, be all about, that's about it/all, and just about as first-class high-frequency constructions.

core_clusters.label_en: on the subject of or connected with
approximately in number, time, amount, or degree
around in different places or directions

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 围绕一个主题/位置，或落在一个数值附近
core_concept.core_meaning_en: around a topic or place, or near rather than exactly at a number, time, amount, or degree
core_concept.mental_model_cn: about 的共同感觉是“围着/附近”：围绕主题 = 关于；围着某处 = 四处；围着一个数 = 大约。
core_concept.mental_model_en: the shared image is around: around a topic, around a place, or around an approximate value

overrides.definition_en: on the subject of or connected with
overrides.sense_label_en: on the subject of; connected with

overrides.definition_en: approximately; a little more or less than a stated number, time, or amount
around in various places or directions
overrides.sense_label_en: around in different places or directions
overrides.usage_note: Less common than around in some varieties, but still ordinary.

constructions.learning_note: Very near future; often something is just about to happen.

constructions.meaning_cn: ……怎么样？（建议、询问或转向另一个对象）
差不多就是这些；大致到此为止
constructions.pattern: that's about it / that's about all

material_changes: Keep all five valid current senses while replacing the one-word mental model with a vertical/scale/text axis model.
Retain above all and promote threshold/comparison and textual-reference patterns into explicit constructions.

core_clusters.label_en: in or to a physically higher position
higher than a number, amount, level, or standard
earlier or higher in a text

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 在空间、尺度或文本顺序上处于“更高/更前”的位置
core_concept.core_meaning_en: higher on a physical axis, a numerical/abstract scale, or the layout/order of a text
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 把 above 看成一条“向上”的轴：空间上方、数值高于阈值、文本里位于上文。
core_concept.mental_model_en: one upward axis applied to space, scales/thresholds, and text position

constructions.meaning_cn: 高于数字、阈值或平均水平

constructions.pattern: as noted/mentioned above; the above + noun
